entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I'm calling about an order. I'm just so disappointed, I don't know what to do.
Oh no, I'm very sorry to hear that. I'm here to help. To get started, can I have your name and order number?
It's Michael Smith, order number VF78910. I've been a loyal customer for years and I've never had a problem like this. It's really disheartening.
Thank you, Michael. I see your order here for the Pro-Line jersey. I appreciate your loyalty with VeloFit, and I want to get this sorted out for you. What specifically is the issue with the jersey?

It's the wrong size. I always get a medium, but this one is just way too tight. I can barely breathe in it. I was really counting on this for a big ride this weekend... I saved up for it, and now I can't even use it.
I can definitely understand your frustration, especially with an event coming up. It sounds like you'd like to do an exchange for a size that fits you properly. Is that right?
Yes, I hope so. I really needed this money to go towards gear that works, you know? I'd hate to be out of pocket for something I can't wear.

Of course not. Let me just check the policy for you. I see you received the item 7 days ago, and our standard items have a 90-day return window. So you are well within the timeframe for a return or an exchange.
Oh, thank goodness. That's a huge relief. So I can definitely swap it?

Absolutely. I can start that exchange process for you right now. And since you're a VIP member and to apologize for the sizing inconvenience, I'm going to waive the return shipping fee and provide complimentary expedited shipping on the new jersey. We'll get a Large sent out to you immediately.
Wow, really? That's... that's fantastic. You have no idea how much that helps. Thank you so much, Sarah.
It's my pleasure, Michael. I'm sending the pre-paid return label for the jersey that's too tight to your email now. Your new order is confirmed. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's everything. You've really turned my day around. Thank you.
You're most welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great ride this weekend!
